cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set 2024-25, section G, which ticks '2025-2026 costs not available' (final figures expected 15 July 2025) and gives estimates: in-state tuition $8,038, out-of-state / nonresident tuition $24,715, required fees $3,916, on-campus food and housing $15,142 (housing $9,910 + meal plan $5,232). Estimated expenses: books $1,084, transportation $3,840, other $4,044 (other shown = transportation + other). Per CDS H6, institutional need-based aid is NOT available to nonresident undergraduates but non-need-based aid is: 87 degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $13,540.

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2024-25 (fall 2024 entering class): 47,065 applied, 34,513 admitted, 7,925 enrolled; residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International first-years: 1,573 applied, 752 admitted (48%), 80 enrolled. Undergraduate enrollment (34,242) is B1 'Total all undergraduates' and the 523 nonresident count is the 'Total Undergraduates' column of B2. Test scores: 7% of enrolled first-years submitted SAT and 40% ACT. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column (a further 0.01% had a GPA below 1.0). The waitlist counts in C2 are blank in the CDS, so waitlist figures are left empty. No early decision or early action; rolling admission. LSU's 2025-26 CDS was not on the CDS page when opened.
